note: fixed by 35140fb (tests: tools/test/orchestrator.test.mjs 'added-code check: a failed or cut-off git diff counts as sensitive (fail closed)' and 'orch-state.mjs: unknown flags (--root among them), a value that looks like a flag and unsafe card values are refused'). (1) The diff command's added-code scan ignores git's exit status and spawnSync's default 1 MB maxBuffer: a failed or cut-off 'git diff -U0' yields empty or partial output, so a diff that adds auth code is reported as not sensitive and the security reviewer is skipped (fail open). (2) parseArgs accepts any flag and the script honours '--root <dir>': 'orch-state.mjs set --root ../other-repo ...' reads and writes another project's status.json and runs git there, and an unknown or misspelt flag (or '--reason' followed by '--x') is silently taken as true instead of refused.
